function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to real‑time data.

According to policy, we should not fabricate. We can use the function to get the current time? There's no function for time. We could approximate using known timezone offset. But we don't have real-time data. We can respond with a disclaimer that we cannot provide real-time data. Or we can approximate based on UTC offset. But it's better to say we can't provide real-time data. The policy says: "If the user requests real-time data or location-based data that is not available in the knowledge base, the assistant should respond with a brief apology and a statement that it does not have access to real-time data." So we should do that.
